rites.name: Dranodath
rites.text: Dranodath is the concept of the sounding that first binds the roots of Mieneth into the ground, a hum felt as much as heard. It is the pattern the first groves took as they learned to hold their shape against the drift of the young world.

rites.name: Miamiel
rites.text: Miamiel is the concept of resonance itself, the note that holds the young world's roots together as they condense out of the Singing. Temples of the Holy Age tune their flames to her, and her presence is felt most as a steady hum beneath stone and ember.

rites.name: Tarnorden
rites.text: Tarnorden is the concept of a bell-like resonance that rang through Mieneth as its first roots condensed out of the Singing. During the Age of Sundering it was said to fracture old bonds wherever it touched, so that landfall itself could split in two.

rites.name: Meravalira
rites.text: Meravalira is the concept of the sworn bond, the promise that holds fractured worlds to one another after the Sundering. In the Age of Sundering its doctrine taught that landfall breaks old oaths only when they go unspoken, and so it became the quiet law the Shards kept.

rites.name: Orienora
rites.text: Orienora is a wild discipline in which the practitioner channels every spell as a burst of creative violence, so that a cast becomes a strike in its own right. Its adepts are feared as much for the scorched rhythm of their blows as for the conjured forces they unleash. The tradition holds that to shape the world with magic is to tear at it, and it lets the body answer each incantation with a blow.

rites.name: Lyareth
rites.text: Lyareth is a pact-bound wellspring of borrowed foresight, a concept drawn from the Arcane realm of Mieneth in its sixth era. Those who bind themselves to it draw strength from a version of themselves who never broke their word to the stars, and every spell costs a little of their remembered tomorrow.

rites.name: Orianniel
rites.text: Orianniel is a revelry-bound oathspirit of Mieneth's Arcane realm, sworn to the vow of the shared table, where laughter and song are treated as sacred wards. Those who stand within its circle gain swift instinct and steadier fortune, and its arcane light can ripple outward to shelter a whole gathering from disaster.

rites.name: Alaana
rites.text: Alaana is a silver-tongued thief of the Mienneth Arcane realm, known for weaving threads of condensed moonlight that let her scale sheer glass towers and bind rivals in shimmering nets. In the sixth age she is said to have unpicked the seal of a sleeping planetary ward without leaving a single trace.

rites.name: Eluamiolwen
rites.text: Eluamiolwen is a concept of sanctioned vegetal sorcery practiced in the crowded districts of Mieneth, where ivy and root-lattices are coaxed through cracked pavement and rooftop gardens. Its adherents bind living growth into the stone bones of the city, letting a single seedling steady a collapsing overpass or thread a warding canopy over a whole quarter.

rites.name: Oriarema
rites.text: Oriarema is a mirror-tongued drifter of the Mieneth arcane courts, who taught herself to braid the hours of a single room into loops of borrowed time. Her gift lets her steal a few seconds from the future and spend them in the present, though every stolen moment ages a lantern-lit ward she carries in her chest.
